_doc: MIDTERMS-WP2-1106 (RC3) and its privacy review (work/WP2-PRIVACY-REVIEW-1106/review.md): Deny-All allowlists for vera/query_terms.extract_terms, the outbound term filter for the GDELT/HN reporting lane and official-lane queries. A capitalised token that is not a registry entity is dropped as a possible personal name unless its lower-case form is in common_capitalised. An all-caps token in mixed-case text is dropped unless it is in known_acronyms (or a registry entity or lexicon word). This file is the ONLY source of both lists: other lanes' word lists (e.g. reporting_lane.json news_intent.event_nouns) are deliberately not read, so editing them cannot widen this privacy filter.
_calibration_note: Curated word lists, not thresholds. Seeded from the RC3 miss (work/MIDTERMS-MISS-1106/diagnosis.md: 'Midterm' and 'US' lost) and the event nouns of reporting_lane.json news_intent as of 2026-11-05, copied explicitly without 'strike' (a surname) and with 'poll' left out (a surname); checked offline against the given-name and surname list in tests/test_query_terms_1106.py, not measured on production traffic. Add a common noun only if it is not also a common given name or surname. Add an acronym only if it names an institution, place, measure or field, never a person's initials (no AOC, RFK, JFK, MTG, DJT, JR). OR, AND and NOT are refused whatever is listed.
_r1r4_note: RELEVANCE-R1R4-1106. Curated lists, not thresholds; no numeric value changed. framing_phrases: discourse idioms stripped from outbound news-lane terms (same idea as search_query.GENERIC_PHRASES; seeded from that list, checked offline on the multi-agent question of work/AGENTS-MISS-1106/diagnosis.md, not measured on production traffic). compound_concepts: spellings read as ONE concept (first = canonical). spelling_pairs: British -> American, matched as word stems with an optional s/es/d/ed/ing suffix; replay evidence in work/RELEVANCE-R1R4-1106/replay.md (sky question only; add a pair only after a replay shows a miss). llm_context_cues / demote_cues (R1 relaxation): a compound or component match is backed by an LLM-context cue; a demote cue (reinforcement-learning vocabulary) without an LLM cue keeps a compound match weak (tier 1). Seeded from the AGENTS-MISS-1106 MARL titles (AOAD-MAT, Hanabi) and the ddfix fixtures; offline replay only. demote_when_question_has: the demote applies only to a question with an LLM/orchestration sense, and never when the question itself carries a demote cue (genuine MARL questions). grey->gray removed from spelling_pairs ("Gray market" over-merge, QA F-low).
_gx1106_note: GOLDEN-XFAIL-1106. lexical_resource_cues: curated list, not a threshold. A title with one of these cues is tier 1 at best (never 0) unless the question itself contains a cue; checked offline on the golden set (sky-colour dataset title), not measured on production traffic. compound_concepts gained midterm/mid-term (and plural) and fulldoc_admission.tokenize now applies merge_compounds so admission matches the query side.
_wpq1111_note: WPQ-1111. open_compound.max_pairs: structural bound on how many adjacent content-word pairs of the question's anchor run are sent as ("w1 w2" OR w1w2) and matched open/hyphenated/closed; UNCALIBRATED; SHIPPED 0 (rule off, owner decision 2026-11-11 option b) until PDSA cycle 1; planner prior for turning on is 1, measured only on offline fixtures and the owner's two questions (PDSA cycle 1: raise to 2, add corpus attestation, or set 0 to restore the previous behaviour exactly). No word list. relevance.demote_record_types: the ONE list of OpenAlex record types sorted after research records (ordering only, no role or eligibility change); empty until the type value is observed in a recorded OpenAlex work (PASS C5).
_wpq_c2_1111_note: WPQ-CYCLE2-1111 (WP-G). open_compound.mode: corpus (c2: the closed form must occur in at least min_docs distinct documents of the loaded corpora, in-memory BM25 postings, no DB) | request (c3: the closed form must be a whole title token of at least request_min_records distinct records, distinct normalised titles, of the request's own round-1 results; affects re-ranking and rounds 2+ only) | corpus_or_request. max_pairs 0 disables every mode (SHIPPED 0). min_docs 2 and request_min_records 2 are planner priors, UNCALIBRATED: one occurrence cannot tell a term of art from a typo or a planted page; measured only on offline synthetic pools (work/WPQ-PDSA-1111, cycle 1: 47 questions) and fixtures, live recall unmeasured (identifier-only OpenAlex rule). What would change them: the first post-deploy Ask test of an open compound and the cycle-2 results (work/WPQ-CYCLE2-1111). Junk guard: stopwords and generic scholarly terms come from config/chunk_topic_terms.json (single source); closed form 6-24 letters.
